reason: A one-for-one bonus issue leaves the free shares valued at the old average cost, matching the bonus adjustment defect.
The 16-bit rain counter wraps after 65,535 tips, an overflow defect absent from the fixed bugs.
Repeated execution of the same dose alarm after reboot matches duplicate alarm recreation, rather than the missing alarms in #2118.
The submit request finishes before the pending autosave, reproducing the last-answer submission race.
5.3 multiplied by 18 twice is approximately 1,717, matching the shared UnitConverter double conversion defect.
DriverBriefing.notice independently omits cache eviction and was outside the StationBoard.notice fix, which still works.
Only the recommendation row exposes the restricted title while search filters correctly, so the search defect has not returned.
WarehouseScanner.service_day independently takes the UTC date and was outside the working DispatchManifest.service_day patch.
A quick successful export omitting only 31 August indicates a date-boundary defect, not the fixed large-export timeout.
CourierManifest.contact independently trims a null phone and was outside the still-working SpecimenLabel.contact patch.
Free shares issued one-for-one with an apparent doubled cost basis match the bonus average-price defect, not stock-split quantity handling.
Bluetooth is enabled and failures are specific to v3 locks, unlike the fixed missing Bluetooth-off check.
WaypointEditor.height again copies feet directly into metres in the exact method previously fixed.
HandoverPacket.day independently uses the UTC date and was outside the working StationCalendar.day fix.
The affected riders have Bluetooth enabled and can unlock other bikes, isolating a different problem with v3 locks.
AppReservation.claim again separates availability checking from writing without the connector-and-interval lock.
Hard-coded badge colors create a dark-mode contrast failure, unrelated to the fixed label encoding bug.
The preserved late-evening session is assigned to the next day immediately after daylight saving ends, matching the fixed-offset streak defect.
The counter resets precisely beyond the unsigned 16-bit maximum, not because a missing wind reading becomes zero.
StationBoard.notice again retains its saved notice on the update event, reproducing the same invalidation defect.
Exactly one missing workday and counting from the 2nd indicate a date-boundary error rather than floating-point salary rounding.
Add-on bill lines again produce fractional-paise totals rejected by payment links, matching the billing arithmetic defect.
Three-decimal totals on bills with add-ons reproduce the floating-point money defect, not missing first meter readings.
Restricted titles appear only in recommendations while search and Browse correctly hide them, unlike the fixed search filtering bug.
BulkRouteImport.height independently omits feet conversion and was explicitly outside the working WaypointEditor.height patch.
The checkout invoice rounds GST line by line while booking and card totals agree, matching the invoice tax rounding defect.
Bluetooth is on and the failure is limited to new v3 locks, so the old Bluetooth-off check does not explain it.
A late-evening session moves to Sunday after summer time ends and resets the streak, matching stale UTC-offset day assignment.
The session remains in history under the wrong day after the clock change, matching timezone handling rather than missing synced streak data.
Only the checkout invoice differs by a rupee and its GST is rounded per line, reproducing the invoice tax rounding defect.
The one-for-one free share issue with apparent cost assigned to bonus shares matches the unadjusted average buy price defect.
Loading large videos wholly into memory causes thumbnail-related memory exhaustion, unlike the deleted-profile null crash.
CatalogCard.load again retains its stored title after a title-change event, reproducing the same cache invalidation defect.
The reported crash is caused by loading large videos into RAM, not force-unwrapping a deleted user profile.
The reported 1,717 from 5.3 is the approximate result of applying the glucose factor twice through the shared UnitConverter.
